author: Renia & Faxagate
description: Images from Faxagate, descriptions and locations by Renia.

items.desc: In your car, at the beginning.
items.name: The Whistleblower

items.desc: Point your camera at the Asylum from the outside.
items.name: Mount Massive Asylum

items.desc: Once inside the building, head over to the hallway where you'll find Office A214. The document will be at the desk.
items.name: Project Walrider Patient Status Report For William Hope

items.desc: After getting inside the Asylum, get to the library and point your camera to the hanging man.
items.name: I'm Inside

items.desc: After seeing the priest, the document will appear at the reception desk.
items.name: Warrant For Seizure

items.desc: Behind the reception desk, head right towards the security room and enter the first door to the left. Enter the bloody stall and point your camera towards the corpse.
items.name: The Witness

items.desc: Behind the reception desk, head right towards the security room and keep going to the end of the hallway. Enter the open room (A126) and you'll find the document at the desk.
items.name: Project Walrider Profitability Report

items.desc: After you meet the priest at the reception desk, go to the right of the entrance (from your pov, the right of the closed doors) to a big room with a lot of computers. Go to the door with blood on the floor and then grab the archive.
items.name: Project Walrider Patient Status Report For Chris Walker

items.desc: At the end of the east hallway, you'll find room A115 with a bunch of patients watching a broken screen. Point your camera towards the screen to get the recording.
items.name: Broken Men And Dead Television

items.desc: When the fat guy is approaching the security room, enter the locker and film them from within to get the recording. Here is where we learn his name is "CHRIS WALKER" and I will refer to him by that name in the rest of the guide.
items.name: Big Fucking Guy

items.desc: After going through the basement, go through the gap in the wall and look to your right to get the document.
items.name: MKULTRA CIA Hypnotic Homicide

items.desc: After you wake up, record the place you wake up in.
items.name: Father Martin's Cell

items.desc: After getting through the space in the walls and climbing on top of the crate, immediately pull out your camera and record the body and the patient. Don't panic if you don't get it immediately, just keep recording.
items.name: Necromantic

items.desc: After going up the stairs, you'll find a bloody "Down the Drain" sign. Look over to the left to find the document.
items.name: Father Martin, Finger Painter

items.desc: Enter through the broken window and pick the document in the desk.
items.name: Purge Gate Maintenance Memo

items.desc: If you follow the blood trail to the shower room you'll see you'll need a keycard so take the other path and immediately pull out your camera and point it at Chris Walker as the event is brief and easy to miss.
items.name: Total Security

items.desc: After escaping the ambush from the Twins and getting back in, head to the right path and enter the room with the floor of checkered tiles. The document will be on top of a desk.
items.name: Dr. Wernicke Death Certificate

items.desc: When you the place the recording "Total Security" took place, head to the 2nd floor, in one of the illuminated cells you'll find the document.
items.name: Dr. Wernicke Obituary

items.desc: In the sewers, before going through the gap, take the left path instead.
items.name: The Gospel Of Sand

items.desc: After finishing draining the sewers, going under then up again, you'll find an npc that will talk to you past a door. Film this npc and the room for the recording to be acquired. You might have to record even after he stops talking.
items.name: The Doctor Is Dead

items.desc: After going through the catwalks and water, don't crouch down the grate but instead jump towards the catwalk above you to avoid the main path and get the document.
items.name: Still Bleeding

items.desc: Near the end of the sewers section, you'll find a gap in the wall and behind it a small set of stairs going up towards a door. Go past the gap but ignore the stairs and get to the end of the path. Point your camera to the pile of corpses behind the door.
items.name: A Feast For Flies

items.desc: After pushing the object and crouching down to pass through, head opposite to the light and into the dark room then point your camera to the wall to get the recording.
items.name: Organized Torture

items.desc: As soon as you get to the Infirmary, instead of heading through the vent, reach the end of the hallway and grab the document in one of the dark corners of the room.
items.name: Project Walrider Cost Report

items.desc: Once you're able to move, head outside and go towards the npc that's calling you. Once he starts yelling a name, go behind him and under the bed then pull your camera to record the events.
items.name: Dr. Rick Trager

items.desc: Once you're back at being chased, you'll go through a series of vents. The second one will leave you exactly in front of a bathroom, where you'll find the document behind a closed stall.
items.name: Request For Reassigment

items.desc: After the elevator cutscene, just record the body to get the collectible.
items.name: Death of Trager

items.desc: After the elevator, you'll meet the priest. Continue going forward until you're at the locker room, there you'll find the document.
items.name: Persecutorial Delusions

items.desc: Record the man at the burning cafeteria. You'll get the recording near the end of his speech.
items.name: Let It Burn

items.desc: After leaving the burning cafeteria to turn on the sprinklers, instead of going through the gap, go through the dark hallway. You'll find the document on a desk near the outer walls.
items.name: Psychopathological Proximity Stress Disorder Pamphlet

items.desc: After exiting the building, go forwards and at the fountain take the upper left path to the stairs. There you'll find a wall with the text "How Alive Are You" written on it.
items.name: Our Own Personal Calvary

items.desc: After putting out the fire in the cafeteria, go back and enter the kitchen. Head towards the blood and open the closed door to the left of it then point your camera at the bowl of fingers.
items.name: Fingers

items.desc: Before exiting the building, head to the office to the right.
items.name: MKULTRA Program Excerpt

items.desc: After opening the door that requires a key, head to the right and film with night vision to get the recording.
items.name: The Thing In The Dark

items.desc: After crouching down to go through a gap and thus progressing, you'll find this illuminated fountain.
items.name: Don't Drink The Water

items.desc: After entering through the window and reaching the laundry room, pull out your camera towards the machine with the dark stuff and start filming in night vision to get the recording.
items.name: The Sound In The Machine

items.desc: When exiting the laundry room, go right and keep going straight until you reach the staircase. The document will be beneath it.
items.name: Walrider And Nightmares

items.desc: After exiting the laundry room and reaching the illuminated elevator with the wheelchair in front of it, pull out your camera and record the dead body inside of it.
items.name: No Safe Place

items.category: Chapter 7: Return to the Administration Block
items.desc: Once you get to the vents, running away from Chris Walker, instead of going straight towards the body, go to the right and fall to the small office to get the document.
items.name: Billy's Dreams

items.desc: After reaching the elevator past the laundry room, instead of climbing the stairs up, go down through a linear path. You'll find the document at the end on top of the desk.
items.name: Project Paperclip Excerpt

items.desc:
After getting to the room with beds, falling, getting back up and the next room, you'll find the document on top of a bed in a corner. 
Point of no return: Finding the Twins.
items.name: You Promised Me A Rose Garden

items.desc:
After getting the key from the laundry room to the upper floor and progressing, film this room when you reach it (this is before meeting the twins and losing your camera). 
Point of no return: Finding the Twins.
items.name: Lies

items.category: Chapter 7: Return to the Administration Block
items.desc: After pushing the dead corpse in the vent and getting down, go left towards the library. The document will be on a desk at the end.
items.name: The Spirit Breach

items.category: Chapter 7: Return to the Administration Block
items.desc: Once you get to the teather, the screen will turn on. Record the full film to get the recording.
items.name: The Wernicke Exit Interview

items.category: Chapter 7: Return to the Administration Block
items.desc: When exiting the teather towards upstairs, instead of going upstairs, reach the end of the hallway. You'll find the document on top of a table.
items.name: Necrotizing Fasciitis

items.category: Chapter 7: Return to the Administration Block
items.desc: After reaching the 3rd floor and going through the cafeteria, keep going straight (before the gap in the wall) until you find an open room with a tv and a patient praying in front of it. Film the patient to get the recording.
items.name: Static Prayer

items.category: Chapter 7: Return to the Administration Block
items.desc: After going through the gap in the wall, ignore the main path and reach almost the end of the hallway and enter room B329. You'll find the document at the desk.
items.name: The Gospel Of Judas

items.category: Chapter 7: Return to the Administration Block
items.desc: Once you get to the big cross, start filming until you get the recording.
items.name: The Passion Of Father Martin

items.desc: After coming out of the elevator, pull out your camera and record the reception desk.
items.name: Under The Mountain

items.desc: Behind the lab's reception desk.
items.name: The Pride Of Wisdom

items.desc: When entering block A, find the lab titled "A004". You'll find the document by the sink.
items.name: Variant Postmortem

items.desc: Once you reach the window that gives view to the outside, enter the door opposite to the window then film the whiteboard for the recording.
items.name: Morphogenic Formula

items.desc:
Impossible to miss.
After being chased by the ghost/walrider, finish the chase for the cutscene to happen and give you the recording. It'll happen automatically.
items.name: Death Of The Soldier

items.desc: After reaching Block C, you'll find the document at the desk.
items.name: Gods And Monsters

items.desc: Film Wernicke's machine.
items.name: Wernicke's Machine

items.desc: Go down the stairs to Wernicke's machine, you'll find the document in front of you, at the control panel. Very easy to miss since there's a lot to look at.
items.name: Morphogenic Engine Chamber Precautions

items.desc: Go down the stairs to Wernicke's machine and film Billy's body inside the bubble.
items.name: Billy Hope

items.desc: Head to Billy's Life support and before turning the valve, record the tanks.
items.name: Life Support

items.desc: In a transparent office on the catwalks above "Billy's life Support". Get this before using the valve.
items.name: The Modern Prometheus

items.desc: In the sublab generator, right after the decontamination shower, before ripping the cables of the sublab generator.
items.name: Permission To Proceed

items.desc: After doing both the lab support and the generator, hit the command panel and as soon as you're able to move, record the bubble where Billy was in.
items.name: Death Of Hope

items.desc: Sanity check.
items.name: No Collectibles here!

items.desc: Automatically recorded after picking the camera.
items.name: If I Die

items.desc: Once you get to the vents, record the conversation that the two guards are having.
items.name: A radio In The Prison

items.desc: When you are prompted to press a button, start recording and keep recording until you get the collectible.
items.name: The Doctors Are Sick

items.desc: After getting out of the decontamination shower, while being chased by Walrider, you will find it in the small room to the right of the exit door. Away from the main path.
items.name: Resignation Of Waylon Park

items.desc: When you get to the kitchen, pull your camera out and keep going forwards until the cannibal starts speaking. When his dialogue is done, you'll get the recording.
items.name: In the Cannibal's Kitchen

items.desc: Once you get the key for the handcuffs, the document will be in the next room, on a desk.
items.name: Gender Selection In Mount Massive Contractors

items.desc: After getting out of the Crematorium via the brick wall, head to the room to the right with the crosses in the wall. Head behind the altar and the document will be there in the ground.
items.name: God And Family

items.desc: Once you see people running away, keep going until you go through a gap in the wall. There, head to the bathroom stalls, open the middle door and pull out your camera to get the recording.
items.name: Varying Effects

items.desc: After getting to one of those plastic tubes again, eventually you'll have to jump over a window. Once you do, keep going straight a small distance towards the dead end as you'll find the document at the end.
items.name: Lesser Known Ecological Aspects Of Humanity

items.desc: After doing what you have to do in room 237 and going through the gap in the wall, you'll find a lab with a document by the sink.
items.name: Project Walrider Patient Status Report For Frank Manera

items.desc: After getting out of the building, go right and pull out your camera then point it towards the window above you.
items.name: Satisfaction

items.desc:
Keep progressing and once you reach these stairs, go left and go through the linear path while looking for a door to your right with someone playing basketball. Pull out your camera and record when you see them.
This is before the Prison Block door.
items.name: This Is What The Game Is

items.desc: As you progress, you'll go through some ladders, with the second one being longer than the previous one, close to a basketball court. Go all the way up and once you cross the window, go right and enter the booth to find the document.
items.name: The Walrider Delusion

items.desc: After the chase sequence with Chris Walker, you'll encounter the priest writing in the wall. Pull out your camera and start recording for the collectible.
items.name: Down, down, down

items.desc: After going down the hole where the "down the drain" sign is, instead of going to the door that says "EXIT" go to the one opposite to it to find the document on the desk.
items.name: Miscarried Profits

items.desc: After jumping out of the window towards the outside, get down then turn back and look for another open window to enter the small building you were on the roof of.
items.name: The Groom

items.desc: Once you reach the electrical fence/door, there will be an entrance towards a building (church?). You'll find the document in the ground by the locked door.
items.name: Kill Us

items.desc: After reaching the electrical fence and powering the electricity down/off, pull out your camera and run towards the fence while recording it.
items.name: Burning Lights

items.desc: After getting out of the pong via the ladder, look to your right as there will be a hole you'll have to crouch to go through. Pull out your camera before crossing and then film the body.
items.name: An Easy Way Out

items.desc: In the attic, film the hanging body. You'll have to go through its location to finish the game so dont worry about it being an optional path.
items.name: Wise Men

items.desc: In attic, past the hanging body and before pushing aside the unit, find the bed in the corner of the room where the unit is. The document will be there on top of the bed.
items.name: Patient Dennis

items.desc: Once you get down from the attic, film the body. You'll known which one I'm talking about since it is displayed in a very different manner than the other ones. There will also be a radio playing music.
items.name: What Fresh Hell

items.desc: After you get to the table saw cutscene and you're able to move, record the table saw.
items.name: An Unwilling Bride

items.desc: After jumping out the window to the outside, you'll find the document to the right of the fountain.
items.name: Project Walrider Patient Status Report For Eddie Gluskin

items.desc: Before or after getting down from the vent, film the hanging corpses in the gym.
items.name: Blue Beard's Wives

items.desc: After using the key, a cutscene will happen. Start recording as soon as you're able to move and record the notable subject.
items.name: A Widower

items.desc: When exiting the gym, where you used the key, keep going until you find the burning church by the window to your left.
items.name: A Burning Church

items.desc: Not long after you record the church, you'll see a group of soldiers around Trager's body. Film them to get the collectible.
items.name: Serve And Protect

items.desc: After passing the soldiers by the soldiers surrounding Trager and hearing gunshots, you will find the document in an illuminated side office, left of the closed door, right of the hallway.
items.name: Beyond Hope

items.desc: After going through a long hallway where you could see the burning church again, you will go through a room with a dead tv. Get out of that room and check the open dark room to the right, the document is on the table.
items.name: Three Blind Dreamers

items.desc: Film Jeremy Blaire by the exit door before getting close to him.
items.name: Jeremy Blaire
